preconditions.description: The number of pastures n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of paths m is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi, li in paths)
preconditions.description: Each path connects two distinct pastures ai and bi, both between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= 10**9 for ai, bi, li in paths)
preconditions.description: Each path has a length li between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines, one for each path.

postconditions.expression: all(x == -1 or (isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 10**9) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output value is either -1 or an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(x == -1 or (x == min(max(li for ai, bi, li in selected_paths) for selected_paths in valid_pavings) if valid_pavings else -1) for i, x in enumerate(return_value))
postconditions.description: Each output value is the minimum possible length of the longest path in a sunny paving using the first i+1 paths, or -1 if no such paving exists.
